verdict.rationale: Canny documents a public API/developer docs (developers.canny.io) and an MCP server that lets AI tools query feedback, update statuses, link deals, and reply to customers, suggesting broad but not verified full parity with the UI. No OpenAPI spec was found (404s across candidate paths) and no explicit claim that every UI action is API-accessible. Missing for 10: a documented OpenAPI/API reference confirming full endpoint coverage, explicit statement of UI-API parity, and independent confirmation that all admin/UI workflows are scriptable via API.
